scope: Domain port, native BlueZ adapter and independent consumer. Paired-device controls use an isolated protocol fixture. Actual guest BlueZ observation has no controllers. Pairing and desktop injection are pending.

architecture.domain: Validated nonzero transient handles and six-octet addresses; snapshots and commands contain no D-Bus, renderer or desktop types. Snapshot records retain public fields.
architecture.use_case: Pure current-identity, parent, power, blocked and paired-device command policy.
architecture.adapter: One watching worker owns the system-bus connection, unique BlueZ owner, transient catalog and bounded command queue. Signals are pumped during native replies. Observed removals retire dependent handles; reconnect allocates fresh IDs.
architecture.discovery: Global discovering is separate from discovery acquired by this connection. Start/stop is idempotent for our ownership. Explicit connection close on cancellation/timeouts ends the unique owner even while streams hold references.
architecture.consumer: Independent headless executable consumes the port without a desktop, Wayland, renderer, terminal Bluetooth wizard or permissive agent.
architecture.desktop: No injection or UI replacement in this milestone. Existing Bluetooth entrypoints remain until native pairing and the client are implemented and verified.

bounds.scope: Admission and catalog bounds, not a total byte budget. Incoming deserialization, simultaneous copies and daemon memory remain outside these counts.

protocol: Power, owned/shared discovery, idempotent starts, paired connect/disconnect, trust and targeted forget
Battery-interface removal preserves device identity; device/controller removal, path reuse and owner replacement retire handles
A 512-signal burst does not starve a method reply; timeout recovery rejects retired targets; daemon error bodies remain private
Unrelated property/interface signals do not refresh the catalog; duplicate observer fails without disrupting the first; cancellation closes the unique connection
Absent service, ready empty catalog and disconnected bus remain distinct; cancellation is bounded

reproduced_before_fix.unrelated_signal_idle_regression: Controller catalog reads rose from 2 to 9 after unrelated property signals. The idle path now ignores those signals; the final regression also covers unrelated interface additions/removals.

native.scope: Actual daemon query and executable cancellation. No Bluetooth controller, device/profile, pairing or desktop-panel acceptance.

core_ci.final_evidence_head: Tracked on PR #38; the evidence commit requires its own checks.
